author: Phan__Girl
body: Every Time I try to right-click the book to the server menu my game crashes and I've been using the latest version and it has worked fine until now PLEASE HELP
body_tagged: Every Time I try to right-click the book to the server menu my game crashes and I've been using the latest version and it has worked fine until now PLEASE HELP
title: PLEASE HELP

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
Well, I suggest using 1.8 since it's more compatible then the other versions. If you want to stay on 1.10, then I suggest using /server (servername).
Example: /server Throwback
